entities.summary: Divisional-General Manuel Louis Jean Augustin Ernouf was a French Army officer, colonial administrator and politician who served in the French Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars. He demonstrated moderate abilities as a combat commander; his real strength lay in his organizational and logistical talents. He held several posts as chief-of-staff and in military administration.
